mapper.select: SELECT TASK_INSTANCE_ID, WF_INSTANCE_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, TASK_ID, START_DATE, END_DATE, ERROR_FLAG, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE FROM TASK_INSTANCES WHERE TASK_INSTANCE_ID = #{taskInstanceId}

SELECT i.TASK_INSTANCE_ID, i.WF_INSTANCE_ID, i.WORKFLOW_ID, i.TASK_ID, p.TASK_NAME, p.TASK_TYPE, i.START_DATE, i.END_DATE, i.ERROR_FLAG, i.STATUS, i.ERROR_MESSAGE FROM TASK_INSTANCES i LEFT JOIN TASK_PARAMS p ON i.TASK_INSTANCE_ID = p.TASK_INSTANCE_ID WHERE i.WF_INSTANCE_ID = #{wfInstanceId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.STATUS IN ('COMPLETED','SKIPPED','CANCELED') THEN 1 WHEN i.STATUS IN ('WAITING') THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, i.START_DATE,i.END_DATE, i.TASK_INSTANCE_ID

SELECT TASK_INSTANCE_ID, WF_INSTANCE_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, TASK_ID, START_DATE, END_DATE, ERROR_FLAG, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE FROM TASK_INSTANCES WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND WF_INSTANCE_ID = #{wfInstanceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TASK_INSTANCES (TASK_INSTANCE_ID, WF_INSTANCE_ID, WORKFLOW_ID, TASK_ID, START_DATE, END_DATE, ERROR_FLAG, STATUS) VALUES (#{taskInstanceId}, #{wfInstanceId}, #{workflowId}, #{taskId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{errorFlag}, #{status})
